questions.question: Sapna invested ₹20,300 on simple interest, partly at 11% per annum and partly at 3% per annum. If she earns equal interests from the two investments after 5 years, then find the sum invested at 11% per annum (in ₹).

Ratio of investments P₁ : P₂ = R₂ : R₁ = 3 : 11

questions.question: Th prime numbers lying between 430 and 443, both included, is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Check the odd numbers between 430 and 443 by eliminating multiples of 3, 5, and divisibility by primes up to 19.

Odd numbers: 431, 433, 435, 437, 439, 441, 443.

Eliminate 435 (ends in 5), 441 (sum of digits is 9 → div by 3), and 437 (19 × 23).

The remaining 4 numbers (431, 433, 439, 443) are not divisible by any prime ≤ 19, hence they are prime.

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Range of numbers: 430 to 443 (both included).

**Method Used:**

To check if a number N is prime, we test its divisibility by all prime numbers less than or equal to √N.

For N ≈ 443, √443 ≈ 21.04. So, we test divisibility by primes: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, and 19.

**Calculations:**

⇒ First, eliminate all even numbers (divisible by 2): 430, 432, 434, 436, 438, 440, 442.

⇒ Now, list the remaining odd numbers: 431, 433, 435, 437, 439, 441, 443.

⇒ Eliminate numbers ending in 5 (divisible by 5): 435.

⇒ Eliminate numbers where the sum of digits is divisible by 3: 441 (4 + 4 + 1 = 9).

⇒ Test the remaining numbers (431, 433, 437, 439, 443) for divisibility by 7, 11, 13, 17, and 19.

⇒ 431: Not divisible by 7, 11, 13, 17, or 19. (Prime)

⇒ 433: Not divisible by 7, 11, 13, 17, or 19. (Prime)

⇒ 437: Divisible by 19 (19 × 23 = 437). (Composite)

⇒ 439: Not divisible by 7, 11, 13, 17, or 19. (Prime)

⇒ 443: Not divisible by 7, 11, 13, 17, or 19. (Prime)

⇒ The prime numbers are 431, 433, 439, and 443.

⇒ Total count of prime numbers = 4.

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Prime Number Property

A number N > 1 is prime if it is not divisible by any prime number less than or equal to √N.

Twin Primes

Two prime numbers whose difference is exactly 2 are called twin primes. For example, (431, 433) form a twin prime pair.

Co-prime Numbers

Two numbers are considered co-prime (or mutually prime) if their highest common factor (HCF) is 1. They do not necessarily have to be prime individually.

questions.question: Two times the present age of P exceeds the present age of Q by 41 years. After 7 years, nine times Q’s age will be 24 years less than six times P’s age at that time. What is the present age (in years) of Q?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Present condition: 2P − Q = 41.

Condition after 7 years: 9(Q + 7) = 6(P + 7) − 24 ⇒ 9Q + 63 = 6P + 18.

Rearranging and dividing by 3, we get: 2P − 3Q = 15.

Subtract this from the first equation: (2P − Q) − (2P − 3Q) = 41 − 15.

⇒ 2Q = 26 ⇒ Q = 13.

**∴ The correct answer is 13 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Two times P's present age exceeds Q's present age by 41 years.

After 7 years, 9 times Q's age is 24 less than 6 times P's age.

 
 Present Age
 P = P, Q = Q
 2P − Q = 41
 
 

 

 +7 Years
 
 
 After 7 Years
 P = P+7, Q = Q+7
 9(Q+7) = 6(P+7) − 24
 
 Solving gives Q = 13 years

**Calculations:**

Let the present age of P be P and Q be Q.

⇒ 2P − Q = 41

⇒ 2P = Q + 41 --- (Equation 1)

After 7 years, P's age = P + 7 and Q's age = Q + 7.

According to the second condition:

⇒ 9(Q + 7) = 6(P + 7) − 24

⇒ 9Q + 63 = 6P + 42 − 24

⇒ 9Q + 63 = 6P + 18

⇒ 9Q + 45 = 6P

Dividing the equation by 3:

⇒ 3Q + 15 = 2P

Substitute 2P from Equation 1:

⇒ 3Q + 15 = Q + 41

⇒ 2Q = 26

⇒ Q = 13

**∴ The correct answer is 13 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ages Concept Basic Rule

Always assume the present age as a variable (like x). The age 't' years ago will be (x − t) and 't' years hence will be (x + t).

Linear Equations Method

When solving two equations, equate the coefficients of one variable and subtract or add to eliminate it, finding the value of the other variable quickly.

Ratio Difference Approach

If the age ratio changes from a:b to c:d over 't' years, we can use the cross-multiplication method to quickly find the present age parts instead of solving full equations.
</p

questions.question: Evaluate: (-9) - (-60) ÷ (-10) + (-3) × 7
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply BODMAS rule to resolve the expression based on priority.

D: (−60) ÷ (−10) = 6

M: (−3) × 7 = −21

Expression becomes: −9 − 6 − 21

Calculate sum: −15 − 21 = −36

**∴ The correct answer is −36.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(−9) − (−60) ÷ (−10) + (−3) × 7

**Formula Used:**

BODMAS Rule (Bracket, Order, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Given expression: (−9) − (−60) ÷ (−10) + (−3) × 7

⇒ Step 1 (Division): (−60) ÷ (−10) = 6

⇒ Expression becomes: (−9) − 6 + (−3) × 7

⇒ Step 2 (Multiplication): (−3) × 7 = −21

⇒ Expression becomes: (−9) − 6 + (−21)

⇒ Step 3 (Addition & Subtraction): −9 − 6 − 21

⇒ −15 − 21 = −36

**∴ The correct answer is −36.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

It dictates the sequence of operations: Brackets, Order (powers/roots), Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction. Multiplications and divisions have the same priority and are calculated from left to right, as are addition and subtraction.

Rules of Signs in Multiplication & Division

Positive × Positive = Positive | Negative × Negative = Positive | Positive × Negative = Negative | Negative × Positive = Negative.

Rules of Signs in Addition & Subtraction

When subtracting a negative number, it turns into addition (−(−x) = +x). When adding two negative numbers, add their absolute values and retain the negative sign.
</p

questions.question: The LCM of the numbers 14.2 and 0.05 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Equate the decimal places of both numbers by adding a zero: 14.20 and 0.05.

Temporarily remove the decimal points to treat them as whole numbers: 1420 and 5.

Find the LCM of 1420 and 5: since 1420 is perfectly divisible by 5, their LCM is 1420.

Place the decimal point back after two digits from the right: 14.20.

**∴ The correct answer is 14.2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers: 14.2 and 0.05

**Formula Used:**

LCM of fractions = LCM of numerators ÷ HCF of denominators

**Calculations:**

⇒ First, convert the given decimals into their simplest fractional forms.

⇒ 14.2 = 142/10 = 71/5

⇒ 0.05 = 5/100 = 1/20

⇒ Numerators are 71 and 1. The LCM of (71, 1) = 71

⇒ Denominators are 5 and 20. The HCF of (5, 20) = 5

⇒ LCM of the fractions = 71 ÷ 5

⇒ 71 ÷ 5 = 14.2

**∴ The correct answer is 14.2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF of Fractions

To find the Highest Common Factor (HCF) of fractions, find the HCF of the numerators and divide it by the LCM of the denominators.

Product of Numbers Rule

For any two numbers, the product of the numbers is always equal to the product of their HCF and LCM. Formula: a × b = HCF × LCM.

LCM of Decimals

Ensure all numbers have the same number of decimal digits by padding with zeros. Compute the LCM as if they are whole numbers, then place the decimal point back at the corresponding position.
</p

questions.question: Find the mean proportional of 400 and 4.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is directly given by the formula √(a × b).

Here, the given numbers are a = 400 and b = 4.

Mean proportional = √(400 × 4)

Mean proportional = √1600 = 40

**∴ The correct answer is 40.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First number = 400

Second number = 4

**Formula Used:**

If x is the mean proportional between a and b, then a : x :: x : b, which implies Product of Means = Product of Extremes.

 
 400
 
 :
 
 
 x

 ::

 
 x

 :

 
 4

 Product of Means = Product of Extremes
 x × x = 400 × 4

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the required mean proportional be x.

⇒ According to the continuous proportion: 400 : x :: x : 4

⇒ x × x = 400 × 4

⇒ x² = 1600

⇒ x = √1600

⇒ x = 40

**∴ The correct answer is 40.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

For any two numbers a and b, the mean proportional is the middle term in a continuous proportion. It is given by x = √(ab).

Third Proportional

If a : b :: b : c, then c is called the third proportional to a and b. It is calculated directly as c = b² ÷ a.

Fourth Proportional

If a : b :: c : d, then d is the fourth proportional to a, b, and c. It is found using the relation d = (b × c) ÷ a.

Proportion Rule

In any valid proportion a : b = c : d, the product of the extreme terms is always equal to the product of the mean terms (a × d = b × c).
</p

questions.question: A shopkeeper lists the price of a fan at 44% above its cost price and offers a 25% discount on its list price. If he earns a profit of ₹126, then what is the list price (in ₹) of the fan?

⇒ The sum of angles in ΔABC is 180°.

⇒ ∠BCA = 180° − (∠BAC + ∠ABC)

Properties of a Trapezium

Alternate Interior Angles Theorem

When a transversal intersects two parallel lines, each pair of alternate interior angles is equal (often visualizing a Z-shape).

Isosceles Triangle Theorem

If two sides of a triangle are equal in length, then the angles opposite to those sides are also perfectly equal. The converse property stands true as well.

questions.question: A bus travelling at 84 km/hr completes a journey in 20 hours. What should its speed be to cover the same distance in 10 hours?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When distance is constant, Speed is inversely proportional to Time.

Time ratio = T₁ : T₂ = 20 : 10 = 2 : 1

Speed ratio = S₁ : S₂ = 1 : 2

Given S₁ (1 unit) = 84 km/hr

New speed S₂ (2 units) = 84 × 2 = 168 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 168 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial speed (S₁) = 84 km/hr

Initial time (T₁) = 20 hours

New time (T₂) = 10 hours

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

 
• 
 
 
 

 Distance (D) is Constant
 
 Time = 20 hours
 Speed = 84 km/hr
 
 Time = 10 hours
 Speed = ?

**Calculation:**

⇒ Distance covered = 84 × 20

⇒ Distance = 1680 km

⇒ Now, the same distance is to be covered in 10 hours.

⇒ New Speed = Distance ÷ New Time

⇒ New Speed = 1680 ÷ 10

⇒ New Speed = 168 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 168 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed

Average speed is the total distance traveled divided by the total time taken. If a distance is covered at speed x and the same distance is returned at speed y, Average Speed = 2xy ÷ (x + y).

Relative Speed

For two objects moving in the same direction, relative speed is the difference of their speeds (S₁ − S₂). For opposite directions, it is the sum of their speeds (S₁ + S₂).

Proportionality in Time & Distance

If Distance is constant, Speed ∝ 1 ÷ Time. If Time is constant, Distance ∝ Speed. If Speed is constant, Distance ∝ Time.
</p

questions.question: Find the simple interest on ₹4,000 at 7.5% per annum rate of interest deposited on 9 February 2024 and withdrawn on 10 April 2024.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total time in days = 20 (Feb) + 31 (Mar) + 10 (Apr) = 61 days.

Since 2024 is a leap year, time in years = 61 ÷ 366 = 1/6 year.

Simple Interest = (P × R × T) ÷ 100 = (4000 × 7.5 × 1/6) ÷ 100 = 50

**∴ The correct answer is ₹50.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹4,000

Rate of Interest (R) = 7.5% per annum

Deposition Date = 9 February 2024

Withdrawal Date = 10 April 2024

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 
• 
 
 
 

 Time = 61 days = 1/6 year
 Rate = 7.5% p.a.
 9 Feb 2024
 P = ₹4000
 10 Apr 2024
 SI = ?
 Result: Simple Interest = ₹50

**Calculations:**

⇒ Year 2024 is divisible by 4, hence it is a leap year ∴ Total days in the year = 366 days.

⇒ Days in February (after deposition) = 29 − 9 = 20 days.

⇒ Days in March = 31 days.

⇒ Days in April = 10 days.

⇒ Total Time (in days) = 20 + 31 + 10 = 61 days.

⇒ Time in years (T) = 61 ÷ 366 = 1/6 years.

⇒ SI = (4000 × 7.5 × 1/6) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = (40 × 7.5) ÷ 6

questions.question: Simplify x(4x - 4) + 5(x² - 5) + 12

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Expand the expression directly by multiplying the terms inside the brackets:

⇒ x(4x − 4) = 4x² − 4x

⇒ 5(x² − 5) = 5x² − 25

Combine all parts and add the constant term:

⇒ 4x² − 4x + 5x² − 25 + 12 = 9x² − 4x − 13

**∴ The correct answer is 9x² − 4x − 13.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Expression: x(4x − 4) + 5(x² − 5) + 12

**Calculation:**

Step 1: Distribute x into the first binomial:

⇒ x × 4x − x × 4 = 4x² − 4x

Step 2: Distribute 5 into the second binomial:

⇒ 5 × x² − 5 × 5 = 5x² − 25

Step 3: Write the fully expanded expression by adding all the terms together:

⇒ (4x² − 4x) + (5x² − 25) + 12

Step 4: Group the like terms with the same variable powers:

⇒ (4x² + 5x²) − 4x + (−25 + 12)

Step 5: Perform the addition and subtraction to simplify:

⇒ 9x² − 4x − 13

**∴ The correct answer is 9x² − 4x − 13.**

Like Terms in Algebra

Terms with exactly the same variables raised to the same power are called like terms (e.g., 4x² and 5x²). Only like terms can be combined using addition or subtraction.

 Buy 6, Get 4 Free Offer

questions.question: The sum of the squares of two consecutive even natural numbers is 164. The sum of the numbers is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The squares of even natural numbers are: 4, 16, 36, 64, 100, 144...

By observation, we can see that 64 + 100 = 164.

The two consecutive even natural numbers are √64 = 8 and √100 = 10.

Sum of the numbers = 8 + 10 = 18.

**∴ The correct answer is 18.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The sum of the squares of two consecutive even natural numbers is 164.

**Calculation:**

Let the two consecutive even natural numbers be x and x + 2.

⇒ x² + (x + 2)² = 164

⇒ x² + x² + 4x + 4 = 164

⇒ 2x² + 4x + 4 − 164 = 0

⇒ 2x² + 4x − 160 = 0

Dividing the entire equation by 2, we get:

⇒ x² + 2x − 80 = 0

Factorizing the quadratic equation:

⇒ x² + 10x − 8x − 80 = 0

⇒ x(x + 10) − 8(x + 10) = 0

⇒ (x − 8)(x + 10) = 0

Since the numbers are natural numbers, x must be positive (x > 0).

⇒ x = 8

The first number is 8, and the second number is 8 + 2 = 10.

The sum of these two numbers = 8 + 10 = 18.

**∴ The correct answer is 18.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of First n Natural Numbers

The sum of the first n natural numbers is given by the formula: Sum = n(n + 1) ÷ 2.

Sum of Squares of First n Natural Numbers

The sum of the squares of the first n natural numbers is calculated as: Sum = n(n + 1)(2n + 1) ÷ 6.

Consecutive Even Numbers Property

Consecutive even integers always differ by 2 (e.g., 2n and 2n + 2), and their product is always a multiple of 8.

Nature of Roots in Quadratic Equation

For a quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0, roots are real and distinct if the discriminant D = b² − 4ac > 0.
